confidenceLegend.high: Corroborated by the club's own site or launch release plus at least one independent source.
confidenceLegend.medium: Multiple third-party sources agree, no direct club-published hex found.
confidenceLegend.low: Sources disagree materially, or a single crowd-sourced value only. Verify before print or licensed use.
confidenceLegend.unverified: No trustworthy hex found. Value is null. Do not substitute a guess.

meta.warning: No MLS club publishes a public brand-guidelines PDF with hex values. Every value here is second-hand unless marked high. Print and merchandise work must be verified against each club's own brand team.
meta.printVsScreen: Where a Pantone-derived value and a web-derived value differ, this file carries the web value. For print, request the club's Pantone build.

clubs.name: Atlanta United FC
clubs.notes: Four competing reds in circulation. #80000A is a clear outlier and should be discarded. Black is likely Pantone Black C.

clubs.name: Charlotte FC
clubs.notes: MLS's launch release names four colours including silver, but no source publishes a silver hex. Left null deliberately.

clubs.name: Chicago Fire FC
clubs.notes: Print build of Fire Red is #D50032 (Pantone-derived). #FF0000 is the web value.

clubs.name: Colorado Rapids
clubs.notes: Crest redesign announced April 2026, no launch date. Club confirmed burgundy and light blue are retained, so this palette stands.

clubs.name: Columbus Crew
clubs.notes: Dropped the 'SC' suffix in 2021. Pre-2021 material correctly reads 'Columbus Crew SC'.

clubs.name: D.C. United
clubs.notes: Three-way split on the red: #EF3E42 (club site), #E4002B (Pantone-derived), #D61018 (ESPN). Club site value used. Takes periods, unlike LA Galaxy.

clubs.name: FC Dallas
clubs.notes: Colour names are style-guide-derived and trustworthy; the hex builds are not.

clubs.name: Houston Dynamo FC
clubs.notes: Official name of the orange is disputed between sources ('Wildcatter Orange' vs 'Electric Orange'). Hex is solid.

clubs.name: Inter Miami CF
clubs.notes: CF trails the name. Contrast with CF Montreal, where CF leads.

clubs.name: LA Galaxy
clubs.notes: Five competing golds. Club appears to carry both a Gold and a Dark Gold. No periods in 'LA' -- contrast with D.C. United. Crest marking moved on 8 January 2026: six stars, three per side above the crest, one per MLS Cup title, debuting on the 2026 kits. The league's five-title gold star no longer describes what the club wears.

clubs.name: Los Angeles Football Club
clubs.notes: Six near-identical golds in circulation. 'Glory Red' appears on a single crowd source only. Never 'LA FC' with a space.

clubs.name: Minnesota United FC
clubs.notes: No two sources agree on any of the three values. Verify before use.

clubs.name: CF Montreal
clubs.notes: The e-acute is mandatory in all published copy. Use nameLocalised. CF leads the name. French-first club; Quebec French uses 'soccer', not 'football'.

clubs.name: New England Revolution
clubs.notes: Print build of the red is #C8102E.

clubs.name: New York City FC
clubs.notes: 2025 brand refresh. Pre-2025 values (#6CACE4 / #041E42 / #F15524) are obsolete -- do not inherit them from older references.

clubs.name: New York Red Bulls
clubs.notes: Worst-documented palette in the league: four reds and two yellows across four sources. 'Red Bull New York' is the corporate entity name; 'New York Red Bulls' is the team name used in editorial, standings and headlines. MLS's own style guide lists the tricode as NY; asset filenames and ESPN use RBNY.

clubs.name: Portland Timbers
clubs.notes: The 2013 Timbers Army tifo is credited in press coverage as the inspiration for the three stars on the league crest.

clubs.name: Real Salt Lake
clubs.notes: The bright #F1CB00 gold circulating in older references looks pre-rebrand. Use #DAAA00.

clubs.name: San Diego FC
clubs.notes: The club has publicly named its colours Chrome and Azul but has never published hex values. Azul candidates span #051222 to #06172B. Chrome is defined by the club as reflective -- it arguably has no single hue. The community palette is a gradient, not a fixed value. This club MUST be verified directly before any use.

clubs.name: Seattle Sounders FC
clubs.notes: 2024 brand evolution retuned Rave Green and Pacific Blue and added Heritage Aqua. The pre-2024 green #5D9741 is obsolete.

clubs.name: Sporting Kansas City
clubs.notes: Never 'Kansas City Sporting'. 'Sporting KC' is second reference only.

clubs.name: St. Louis CITY SC
clubs.notes: CITY is all caps -- confirmed on the club's own site. MLS's scores page renders 'St. Louis City SC', which contradicts the club's own branding; follow the club. Club officially names four colours but publishes no hex values for the last two. Reserve side is CITY2.

clubs.name: Toronto FC
clubs.notes: Unresolved three-way split on the red: #A6192E (PMS 187), #AA182C (ESPN), #B81137 (club site). One source cites Pantone 200 C, which converts to none of them.

clubs.name: Vancouver Whitecaps FC
clubs.notes: Ownership and market under review: a Las Vegas investor group's offer to buy the club and relocate it reached the league office on 30 April 2026 and is unresolved as of November 2026. A move needs an MLS Board of Governors vote and a relocation fee. Palette and naming stand until a sale closes; this is the most relocation-exposed entry in this file.
